Return a JSON object of the form {"variant_ids": ["..."]} listing the variant ID of every shade that meets all of my conditions. If nothing in the store meets all of them, return an empty list.

You may think step by step first. End your reply with the JSON object inside a ```json code block.

   - **Kaelo Glass Concealer (`CNC-011`)** – $27.00: Over your $25 budget and has no deep cool shade.
   - **Kaelo Velvet Concealer (`CNC-013`)** – $22.00: Has a deep cool shade (`CNC-013-501C`, Espresso 501C), but it is currently sold out (`stock: 0`), so it cannot be ordered today.
   - **Velmora Soft Focus Concealer (`CNC-014`)** – $26.00: Has a deep cool shade in stock (`CNC-014-501C`, Cocoa 501C), but at $26.00 (no active promotion applies to Velmora), it is not less than $25.

Unfortunately, no in-stock concealer meets all of your criteria today.
